verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a frequentist experimentation engine (RCTs, metric lifts with confidence intervals) plus variance-reduction tooling like CUPED, stratified sampling, and switchback tests via Warehouse Native, giving PMs a documented statistical basis for results (statsig-docs-33, statsig-docs-16, statsig-docs-26). However there's no explicit Bayesian engine option, no independent third-party validation of the stats methodology, and Autotune is a bandit/optimization tool rather than a core inferential engine. Missing for 10: explicit Bayesian analysis option, independent/academic validation of statistical rigor, deeper methodology docs (e.g., sequential testing, sample ratio mismatch handling).
